lines.en: label day318:
scene thisiswar1
: I don’t get it...
lines.zh: : 我不懂……

lines.en: : What part? What aren’t you getting?
lines.zh: : 哪一部分？你哪里不懂？

lines.en: : The part with all the words.
lines.zh: : 有字的那部分。

lines.en: : Uta, you need to help me so {i}I{/i} can help you.
lines.zh: : Uta，你得先帮我，{i}我{/i}才能帮你。

lines.en: : I can’t teach you the words if I don’t know the words that need to be taught.
lines.zh: : 如果我不知道需要教的是哪些词，我就没法教你那些词。

lines.en: scene thisiswar2
: Sensei! I am dumb! Please come help!
lines.zh: : Sensei！我是笨蛋！快来帮忙！

lines.en: : You really think he’s going to do anything to help you in this situation?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得这种情况下他能帮上什么忙？

lines.en: : We’re still two of the newest girls in the[school] and even {i}we{/i} should know that teaching is at the very bottom of his list of interests.
lines.zh: : {i}我们{/i}还算是这所[school]里最新的两个女生，连我们都能看出来，教书在他兴趣清单里排最末一位。

lines.en: scene thisiswar3
: Ugh...stupid standardized test thingies...showing up out of nowhere and reminding us that we’re not all just cruisin’ by without havin’ to work for it.
lines.zh: : 呜……该死的标准化考试什么的……突然冒出来提醒我们，不是所有人都能不劳而获地混过去。

lines.en: : Hey, I’m totally down to help you. I just need to know a little more about what you’re struggling with.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我完全愿意帮你。我只是需要多知道一点你到底卡在哪儿。

lines.en: Hello there.
lines.zh: 你好呀。

lines.en: As you can see, the class is hard at work today.
lines.zh: 如你所见，全班今天都在埋头苦干。

lines.en: Though, some are finding a bit more success than others.
lines.zh: 不过，有些人比另一些人更有成效。

lines.en: I actually don’t mind days like this, where the girls are suddenly hit with reminders through my faithful class representative that they can’t slack off {i}every{/i} day-
lines.zh: 其实我并不讨厌这样的日子——我那位忠实的班长突然让姑娘们想起来，她们不能{i}天天{/i}摸鱼——

lines.en: Because that just means things will be quieter than normal.
lines.zh: 因为那意味着一切会比平常更安静。

lines.en: When things are quieter than normal, I have an easier time sleeping through the[school] day.
lines.zh: 一切比平常更安静的时候，我就更容易睡过整个[school]日。

lines.en: And the sooner the[school] day ends, the sooner I can do the things I actually want to do.
lines.zh: 而这一天的[school]越早结束，我就能越早去做我真正想做的事。

lines.en: IE: Not be in[school].
lines.zh: 也就是：不在[school]里。

lines.en: It’s a little weird how, even though I don’t do any teaching at all, it’s still mentally and physically draining being inside of this place.
lines.zh: 有点奇怪的是，尽管我一点书都不教，待在这个地方还是让我身心俱疲。

lines.en: I guess that’s just one of the effects[school] can have on the mind.
lines.zh: 我想这就是[school]能对心智造成的影响之一吧。

lines.en: Regardless, I’m glad that things are slowing down today.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我很高兴今天节奏慢了下来。

lines.en: Here’s hoping that Uta figures out “the words” or whatever it is she’s struggling with.
lines.zh: 但愿 Uta 能搞明白那些「词」，或者她到底卡在什么东西上。

lines.en: scene thisiswar4
: Hey, what if we stop studying altogether and just guess on all of the answers for the thingy? I’m sure we can fail like one or two of those, right?
lines.zh: : 嘿，要是我们干脆不学了、所有答案都靠猜怎么样？我敢肯定我们挂个一两科也没事吧？

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure we get held back if we fail any of them.
lines.zh: : 我很确定只要挂一科我们就会被留级。

lines.en: : Well then what the heck is the point of normal tests and normal grades if the standardy ones are the only ones that matter?
lines.zh: : 那如果只有标准化考试才算数，普通考试和普通成绩到底还有什么意义啊？

lines.en: : You...do realize we haven’t taken a single “normal” test since we got here, right? They’re like, not even a thing anymore.
lines.zh: : 你……该不会没意识到我们来了之后一场「普通」考试都没考过吧？它们基本上已经不存在了。

lines.en: scene thisiswar5
: Life itself is a test, dearest Io.
lines.zh: : 人生本身就是一场考试，亲爱的 Io。

lines.en: : From the moment we are born to the moment we get cancer and die, every day is a test to see if we’re fit to survive.
lines.zh: : 从我们出生的那一刻，到我们得癌症死掉的那一刻，每一天都是一场考试，看我们是否配活下去。

lines.en: : That’s cool. But if you’re not going to actually use it, can I have my notebook back?
lines.zh: : 说得真好。不过如果你不打算真的用它，能把笔记本还我吗？

lines.en: : Right after you teach me the words.
lines.zh: : 等你教会我那些词再说。

lines.en: scene thisiswar6
: I still don’t know what words you’re even talking about.
lines.zh: : 我还是不知道你到底在说哪些词。

lines.en: scene thisiswar7
: Well, well, well...It seems to me that someone could use a little pick me up.
lines.zh: : 哎呀呀呀……看来有人需要振作一下了。

lines.en: scene thisiswar8
: I may be tiny, but I highly doubt even a skilled martial artist like yourself could just {i}lift{/i} me up out of my chair, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我是很娇小，不过我很怀疑就算是像你这样的武术高手，也没法把我从椅子上{i}拎{/i}起来，Ayane。

lines.en: : So unless you plan on picking up my brain and replacing it with one that has more words, I think you’re better off just going back to your own seat.
lines.zh: : 所以除非你打算把我的脑子拎出来、换成一个词更多的，不然我觉得你还是回自己座位比较好。

lines.en: : Actually, Uta...I was thinking now might be as good a time as any to begin Operation: Firestarter.
lines.zh: : 其实，Uta……我觉得现在这个时机再合适不过了，可以启动「纵火行动」了。

lines.en: scene thisiswar9
: You want to burn the[school] down?! Right now?!
lines.zh: : 你想把[school]烧了？！就现在？！

lines.en: : Of course not. I’d be asking Ami for help if that were the case.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。要是那样的话我就去找 Ami 帮忙了。

lines.en: : That was so long ago! And it only happened once!
lines.zh: : 那都是多久以前的事了！而且就发生过一次！

lines.en: : See? She’s the only experienced arsonist in the class.
lines.zh: : 看吧？她是班里唯一有经验的纵火犯。

lines.en: : Mmmmmmm...you sure about that?
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯嗯嗯……你确定吗？

lines.en: : Please don’t plan to burn the[school] down.
lines.zh: : 别计划把[school]烧掉啊。

lines.en: : This place might suck, but I still rely on it to pay my bills.
lines.zh: : 这地方也许很烂，但我还得靠它付账单呢。

lines.en: : I suppose if Sensei doesn’t like the[school], there isn’t much stopping us from demolishing the place.
lines.zh: : 我想既然 Sensei 也不喜欢这所[school]，那就没什么能阻止我们把这地方拆了。

lines.en: : I am ready when you are, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 你什么时候准备好，我就什么时候上，Ayane。

lines.en: scene thisiswar10
: Okay, you do remember what Operation: Firestarter actually is, right? Because we came up with it together.
lines.zh: : 好了，你总记得「纵火行动」到底是什么吧？毕竟是我们一起想出来的。

lines.en: : Course I remember. Do ya really think now is the best time, though?
lines.zh: : 我当然记得。不过你真觉得现在是最佳时机吗？

lines.en: : Absolutely not.
lines.zh: : 绝对不行。

lines.en: : I don’t know what you two are planning but-
lines.zh: : 我不知道你们两个在策划什么，不过——

lines.en: : Actually, on second thought, what better time than now?
lines.zh: : 其实，再想想，还有比现在更好的时机吗？

lines.en: : Touka and Yasuyasu are finally startin’ to show some chemistry, so there’s nothin’ else holdin’ us back.
lines.zh: : Touka 和 Yasuyasu 终于开始擦出火花了，所以没什么别的事拖着我们了。

lines.en: scene thisiswar11
: Hm? Did someone say Touka?
lines.zh: : 嗯？有人提到 Touka 吗？

lines.en: : Am I being included in [high_school] gossip? Is it good or bad?
lines.zh: : 我被卷进[high_school]的八卦里了吗？是好话还是坏话？

lines.en: : Please tell me.
lines.zh: : 请告诉我。

lines.en: : Fact is, even if we do fail our tests, we’ll still have fun in the process. So it will all be worth it in the long run.
lines.zh: : 事实是，就算我们考砸了，过程中我们也会玩得很开心。所以长远来看都值得。

lines.en: : You should still study. Education is important and I’m only suggesting this since I’m kind of smart.
lines.zh: : 你还是该学习。教育很重要，而我之所以这么建议，是因为我还算聪明。

lines.en: : You slimy bastard.
lines.zh: : 你这滑头的混蛋。

lines.en: scene thisiswar12
: Okay. I don’t have to be involved. Please enjoy your conversation that may or may not be about me.
lines.zh: : 好吧。我不必掺和。请继续你们这场可能有关、也可能无关我的对话吧。

lines.en: : You should probably be studying, Uta. You can’t really afford to goof off right now.
lines.zh: : 你大概该在学习了，Uta。你现在可没闲工夫偷懒。

lines.en: : Also, if you get held back, I won’t have anyone else to talk to and that would suck.
lines.zh: : 而且如果你留级了，我就没人可以说话了，那会很糟糕。

lines.en: : Hey, the offer to hang out with Noriko and me is still-
lines.zh: : 嘿，跟我和 Noriko 一起玩的邀约还是——

lines.en: : Please don’t talk to me. I’m studying.
lines.zh: : 请别跟我说话。我在学习。

lines.en: : Ayane, I’m glad you chose today as the day to remind me that I don’t care about learning.
lines.zh: : Ayane，我很高兴你挑今天来提醒我：我根本不在乎学习。

lines.en: : That’s not really what I was-
lines.zh: : 我其实不是那个——

lines.en: : Because if there’s anything that’s going to motivate me to study harder, it’s not studying at all!
lines.zh: : 因为要说有什么能激励我更努力学习，那就是完全不学习！

lines.en: : Amen to that, Uta!
lines.zh: : 说得太对了，Uta！

lines.en: scene thisiswar13
: So, with that in mind...I believe it is time for us to begin phase one.
lines.zh: : 那么，抱着这个念头……我认为是时候开始第一阶段了。

lines.en: : Hostile takeover?
lines.zh: : 恶意收购？

lines.en: : Hostile takeover.
lines.zh: : 恶意收购。

lines.en: : Hostile what now?
lines.zh: : 恶意什么？

lines.en: : Ayane, if you’re still bringing guns to[school] after all of the incidents with the janitors, I’m going to have to step in and-
lines.zh: : Ayane，如果在出了那么多保洁员事件之后你还敢带枪来[school]，我就不得不出面——

lines.en: scene black
: Wait, what are you doing?
lines.zh: : 等等，你们在干什么？

lines.en: : Step aside, Sensei! This is our classroom now! Me and Ayane are about to blow your-
lines.zh: : 让开，Sensei！现在这是我们的教室了！我和 Ayane 要吹爆你的——

lines.en: : Penis!
lines.zh: : 鸡巴！

lines.en: : Mind!
lines.zh: : 大脑！

lines.en: : Penis...mind?
lines.zh: : 鸡巴……大脑？

lines.en: : I wouldn't say they’re entirely wrong considering it is {i}your{/i} mind, but I still can’t condone-
lines.zh: : 考虑到那确实是{i}你的{/i}脑子，我也不能说她们全错，但我还是没法纵容——

lines.en: : Wait! What are you two doing?! Get your hands off of him!
lines.zh: : 等等！你们两个在干什么？！把你们的手从他身上拿开！

lines.en: scene thisiswar14
: You know, I was really hoping things were about to go in a different direction when I heard the “penis” thing, but-
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我听到「鸡巴」那句的时候，真的很期待事情往另一个方向发展，不过——

lines.en: : Nodoka.
lines.zh: : Nodoka。

lines.en: : Yes?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : Now is not the time.
lines.zh: : 现在不是时候。

lines.en: : I beg to differ, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 恕我不敢苟同，Sensei。

lines.en: : Ayane, Uta...why am I sitting at this desk?
lines.zh: : Ayane，Uta……我为什么坐在这张桌子前？

lines.en: scene thisiswar15
: {i}Because you’re about to be[school]ed, bitch.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}因为你马上就要被[school]教育了，婊子。{/i}

lines.en: : Excuse me?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : Don’t call my husband a bitch, Uta. Remember that his role in all of this is just as important as ours.
lines.zh: : 别叫我丈夫婊子，Uta。记住他在这件事里的角色跟我们一样重要。

lines.en: : Look at him, cozied up at a [high_school]er’s desk like he’s pretending to be [young]again.
lines.zh: : 看看他，舒舒服服坐在一张[high_school]生的桌子前，好像在假装自己又[young]了一样。

lines.en: : You literally pushed me here.
lines.zh: : 明明是你们把我推过来的。

lines.en: : So weak. So childish.
lines.zh: : 好弱。好幼稚。

lines.en: scene thisiswar16
: Okay, seriously. Stop.
lines.zh: : 好了，说真的。够了。

lines.en: : I’m sorry! I’m just gettin’ fired up thinking about how we’re going to be spending the next two days starting...RIGHT NOW! GO!
lines.zh: : 对不起！我只是想到接下来两天我们要怎么过就热血沸腾，从现在就开始！上啊！

lines.en: scene thisiswar17
: Students! Teacher! Molly!
lines.zh: : 同学们！老师！还有 Molly！

lines.en: : Why just Molly?! What did I do?!
lines.zh: : 为什么单说 Molly？！我做了什么？！

lines.en: : If you have been eavesdropping on my desperate pleas for help, first of all, shame on you!
lines.zh: : 如果你们一直在偷听我绝望的求助，首先，你们真丢人！

lines.en: : Second, you probably overheard a conversation about Ayane and me burning down the[school]!
lines.zh: : 其次，你们大概偷听到了我和 Ayane 要烧掉[school]的对话！

lines.en: : Do not fear! That will not be happening!
lines.zh: : 别怕！那不会发生！

lines.en: A scattered, awkward applause started by Rin quickly spreads throughout the classroom.
lines.zh: Rin 起的头，零零散散、略显尴尬的掌声很快传遍了整个教室。

lines.en: : But what we {i}will{/i} do...is set a fire under your asses! For now is the time to get down and groovy!
lines.zh: : 但我们{i}要{/i}做的……是在你们屁股底下点把火！现在是时候嗨起来了！

lines.en: Oh. I’m guessing this is the “orgy of fun” that was recently proposed.
lines.zh: 哦。我猜这就是最近被提议的那场「欢乐的狂欢」。

lines.en: I’m still hoping it’s an actual orgy. Though the idea of it lasting two full days like Uta suggested is mildly intimidating.
lines.zh: 我仍然希望它是一场真正的群交。不过像 Uta 说的那样持续整整两天，这个想法多少有点吓人。

lines.en: But if anyone is up to the task, it’s me.
lines.zh: 不过如果有人能扛得下来，那一定是我。

lines.en: I begin to slide off my shirt and-
lines.zh: 我开始脱掉衬衫，然后——

lines.en: : Um...Sensei?
lines.zh: : 呃……Sensei？

lines.en: : Now is probably not the best time...
lines.zh: : 现在大概不是时候……

lines.en: : Fine. I’ll wait for someone else to go first.
lines.zh: : 好吧。我等别人先来。

lines.en: : I can take the back seat every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 偶尔坐在后座我也无所谓。

lines.en: : So, Uta and I have been doing a lot of talking lately, and we think it might be good for us to have a little bonding exercise now that our class is finally full.
lines.zh: : 那么，我和 Uta 最近聊了很多，我们觉得既然班里人终于齐了，做个小小的联谊活动也许不错。

lines.en: : That’s how it {i}started{/i}, at least...
lines.zh: : 至少{i}一开始{/i}是这样……

lines.en: : Right. But in beginning to talk about different ways to bond, it quickly became apparent that there is a big point of contention between the two of us.
lines.zh: : 对。不过在讨论各种联谊方式的过程中，很快就暴露出我们俩之间有一个很大的分歧。

lines.en: : Ayane thinks her floor is better than ours! And we must show her that she is wrong!
lines.zh: : Ayane 觉得她那层楼比我们好！我们必须让她知道她错了！

lines.en: : Rise up, second floor! And Molly!
lines.zh: : 站起来吧，二楼！还有 Molly！

lines.en: : I AM ON THAT FLOOR TOO!
lines.zh: : 我也在那层楼上啊！

lines.en: scene thisiswar18
: I don’t know what gave Uta the idea that the second floor was better than the first, but I’m pretty sure it has something to do with finally being at a higher elevation than other girls her age.
lines.zh: : 我不知道 Uta 哪来的念头觉得二楼比一楼好，不过我敢肯定，跟她终于能处在比同龄女孩更高的海拔上有关。

lines.en: : I’ll have you know that I am one whole inch taller than Sana. And sometimes one inch is all that matters.
lines.zh: : 我可告诉你，我比 Sana 整整高了一英寸。有时候一英寸就够了。

lines.en: : Isn’t that right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 我说得对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: : I don’t think it would make that much of a difference for me.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这对我也没多大区别。

lines.en: : Heheh...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……

lines.en: : Yes. You could lose one inch and still be taller than all of us.
lines.zh: : 是的。就算少一英寸，你也还是比我们所有人都高。

lines.en: : You are a large man.
lines.zh: : 您是个大块头。

lines.en: : Thanks, Tsuneyo. That’s exactly what I was referring to.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Tsuneyo。我指的正是这个。

lines.en: : Anyway, the two of us thought it might be good to start a little...friendly competition to truly show everyone, once and for all, which floor is the better floor.
lines.zh: : 总之，我们俩觉得可以搞一个小小的……友谊赛，一次性、彻底地向所有人证明哪一层楼更好。

lines.en: : And so! I will be the captain of my floor and Ayane will be the captain of-
lines.zh: : 那么！我来当我们这层的队长，Ayane 当——

lines.en: scene thisiswar19
: Absolutely not!
lines.zh: : 绝对不行！

lines.en: : We’re going to have our next batch of standardized tests any day now. And you should know more than anyone how crucial it is to be studying at a time like this!
lines.zh: : 我们随时都会有下一批标准化考试。而现在这种时候该多努力学习，你比谁都清楚！

lines.en: : Also, the first floor is clearly better and the fact that you think you can disprove that with a stupid contest is laughable.
lines.zh: : 再说，一楼明显更好，你以为靠一场蠢比赛就能推翻这一点，简直可笑。

lines.en: : Hey now...I wouldn’t say {i}laughable{/i}. There’s plenty of stuff our floor is better at.
lines.zh: : 哎，别这么说……我可不会说{i}可笑{/i}。我们那层楼擅长的事多了去了。

lines.en: : That may be true, but I absolutely will not support a contest to prove that.
lines.zh: : 这也许是事实，但我绝对不会支持用比赛来证明这一点。

lines.en: scene thisiswar20
: Wow. That was pretty much word for word how you said she would react.
lines.zh: : 哇。这简直跟你说的她的反应一字不差。

lines.en: : Yeah. I was more or less prepared for this.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我多少已经准备好了。

lines.en: : Don’t make me sound like some sort of predictable-
lines.zh: : 别把我说得好像很容易被预料到似的——

lines.en: scene thisiswar21
: You can be captain of the first floor, Makoto.
lines.zh: : Makoto，你可以当一楼的队长。

lines.en: : It should be okay that way, right?
lines.zh: : 那样应该没问题吧？

lines.en: scene thisiswar22
: Sure! Why not?
lines.zh: : 当然！为什么不呢？

lines.en: : You already lead the classroom and you’re the student council president, so you definitely have the experience.
lines.zh: : 你已经在管着这个班了，还是学生会主席，所以你绝对有经验。

lines.en: : Besides, we’re going to win either way, so it doesn’t really matter {i}who{/i} the captain is.
lines.zh: : 再说，反正我们会赢，所以队长是{i}谁{/i}其实无所谓。

lines.en: : Well...I suppose it does sound like a good bonding experience. And the second floor could certainly use that given that they’re all still relatively new here.
lines.zh: : 嗯……听起来确实是个不错的联谊活动。而二楼那些人毕竟还都相对比较新，确实需要这个。

lines.en: : But...the winners would need to get something to make it worth while. Wouldn’t they?
lines.zh: : 不过……赢家总得拿到点什么才算值得吧？不是吗？

lines.en: : Otherwise, it’s just a waste of time and-
lines.zh: : 否则就只是浪费时间，而且——

lines.en: scene thisiswar23
: Oh, we’ve already decided on what the winner gets.
lines.zh: : 哦，赢家能得到什么我们已经定好了。

lines.en: : And it’s a lot more than just bragging rights.
lines.zh: : 而且远不止是吹牛的资格。

lines.en: : That’s right, Ayane...In fact, it’s the most sought after award in the[school].
lines.zh: : 没错，Ayane……事实上，这是这所[school]里最抢手的奖励。

lines.en: : S-Sought after?...
lines.zh: : 最……最抢手？……

lines.en: : Then...wouldn’t that mean...
lines.zh: : 那么……岂不是意味着……

lines.en: scene thisiswar24
: THE WINNER GETS SENSEI!
lines.zh: : 赢家得到 SENSEI！

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Is it too late to drop out of the contest?
lines.zh: : 现在退出比赛还来得及吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, I can sit this one out too. Give him to somebody else.
lines.zh: : 是啊，这个我也可以不参加。把他给别人吧。

lines.en: : What the fuck?
lines.zh: : 什么鬼？

lines.en: : Specifically, whichever floor wins will get to keep him in their room for the upcoming beach trip.
lines.zh: : 具体来说，哪一层赢了，就能在即将到来的海滩之行里把他留在她们房间。

lines.en: : So you better start packin’ your PJ’s now, Sensei. You’re gonna be with us second floor girls whether Otoha likes it or not.
lines.zh: : 所以你最好现在就开始收拾睡衣吧，Sensei。不管 Otoha 乐不乐意，你都得跟我们二楼的姑娘们待在一起。

lines.en: scene thisiswar25
: Oooooh, that {i}is{/i} a good reward.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，这奖励{i}不错{/i}啊。

lines.en: : How do we win?! What do I do?! What is the dress code for the sleepover?!
lines.zh: : 我们要怎么赢？！我该做什么？！睡衣派对的着装要求是什么？！

lines.en: : You can’t win.
lines.zh: : 你们赢不了。

lines.en: : Us first floor girls have been with Sensei much longer than any of you.
lines.zh: : 我们一楼的姑娘跟 Sensei 在一起的时间比你们谁都长。

lines.en: : Sounds to me like somebody is forgetting {i}I’ve{/i} been with Sensei longer than anyone except for like, Ami I guess.
lines.zh: : 听这口气，好像有人忘了，除了 Ami 大概没人比{i}我{/i}跟 Sensei 更久了。

lines.en: : I don’t care if I have to carry the entire floor. I’m {i}going{/i} to win and I’m {i}going{/i} to get all up in his business at our swimsuit slumber party thingy.
lines.zh: : 就算要我一个人撑起整层楼我也不在乎。我{i}一定{/i}会赢，然后在我们的泳装睡衣派对上把他摸个遍。

lines.en: scene thisiswar26
: Lay so much as a finger on him and you will die.
lines.zh: : 你敢碰他一根手指头，你就死定了。

lines.en: : Joke's on you. I'm perfectly content dying for that.
lines.zh: : 你失算了。为了这个去死我心甘情愿。

lines.en: : You underestimate me, Chika.
lines.zh: : 你太低估我了，Chika。

lines.en: scene thisiswar27
: Are you okay with these terms, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 这些条件你接受吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : He’s okay with them as long as our floor wins and he gets to sleep in the bed with me.
lines.zh: : 只要我们这层赢、他能跟我睡一张床，他就接受。

lines.en: : Better idea: What if all twenty-one of us just sleep in the same bed and-
lines.zh: : 我有个更好的主意：要不我们二十一个人全睡一张床——

lines.en: : No can do, Sensei. I appreciate you openly admitting that you want to sleep in the bed with me, even though I’ve known it all along-
lines.zh: : 不行，Sensei。我很欣赏你公开承认想跟我睡一张床，虽然我早就知道了——

lines.en: : But the show must go on and the combatants must be chosen.
lines.zh: : 不过戏还是得演下去，选手也必须定下来。

lines.en: : So please, here and now, surrender your rights and agree to room with whoever the winner of the contest is.
lines.zh: : 所以拜托了，此时此刻，放弃你的权利，答应跟比赛的赢家住一间房。

lines.en: : I don’t really like calling it “surrendering my rights” but...if all that’s going to happen is me sleeping next to a bunch of girls, sure.
lines.zh: : 我不太喜欢「放弃我的权利」这个说法，不过……如果只是让我挨着一群女孩睡，行吧。

lines.en: : Perfect!
lines.zh: : 完美！

lines.en: : Now, please exit the room so we can figure out who is up against who and blah blah blah logistical stuff.
lines.zh: : 现在，请离开教室，我们好决定谁对谁，还有各种 blah blah blah 后勤的事。

lines.en: : You’re going to need the rest anyway, Sensei. These next two days are going to be action-packed, especially since you'll be acting as a judge for some of the competitions.
lines.zh: : 反正你也需要休息，Sensei。接下来两天会非常紧凑，尤其是有些项目你还得当裁判。

lines.en: : I actually have to participate? I can’t just surrender myself and be done with it?
lines.zh: : 我真得参加吗？我就不能直接把自己交出去然后一了百了？

lines.en: : Oh you’ll be participating, alright. This contest can’t exist without you.
lines.zh: : 哦，你会参加的，没错。这场比赛没有你就不存在。

lines.en: : Now get the heck out of my classroom so me and Makoto can start whippin’ our girls into shape!
lines.zh: : 现在赶紧滚出我的教室，好让我和 Makoto 开始把我们的姑娘们操练起来！

lines.en: : I’m down to get whipped if Uta is offering. Sounds fun.
lines.zh: : 如果是 Uta 来抽我，我倒是很乐意。听起来挺好玩。

lines.en: : I’ve never really looked at her like that, but I probably wouldn’t refuse if Makoto wanted to whip me as-
lines.zh: : 我还真没那样看过她，不过要是 Makoto 想抽我的话，我大概也不会拒绝——

lines.en: : No one is whipping anyone! But yes, Sensei, please vacate the premises.
lines.zh: : 没人要抽任何人！不过是的，Sensei，请离开现场。

lines.en: : It appears that Uta and I have quite a bit to talk about...
lines.zh: : 看来我和 Uta 有不少要谈的……

lines.en: scene black
{i}Welcome to the first annual Super Mega Ultimate Dorm War!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}欢迎来到首届超级无敌究极宿舍大战！{/i}

lines.en: {i}The next two days will be completely filled with events featuring head to head battles between two girls from each floor.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}接下来两天将完全被各种项目填满，每层楼各出一名女生进行一对一的对抗。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Some events will have predetermined outcomes, but several of them have outcomes that you will be able to choose!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}有些项目的结果是预先设定的，但也有几个项目的结果将由你来选择！{/i}

lines.en: {i}In the end, only one floor can be crowned as the winner!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}最终，只有一层楼能加冕为胜者！{/i}

lines.en: {i}So sit back, relax, and do the thing!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}所以，坐好、放松，然后开始吧！{/i}
